sloka: अथ नामाकरोत्तस्य पितामहसमः पिता ।दशग्रीवः प्रसूतो ऽयं दशग्रीवो भविष्यति ।। ७.९.३२ ॥
transliteration: atha nāmākarottasya pitāmahasamaḥ pitā ।daśagrīvaḥ prasūto 'yaṁ daśagrīvo bhaviṣyati ।। 7.9.32 ॥

translations.english: Then his father, who was like his grandfather (Brahma), named him Daśagrīva, declaring that this newborn would indeed be Daśagrīva (ten-necked).
